items.description: Glazed ceramic floor tiles, 600 mm x 600 mm, porcelain body

B/L shows 24,080 kg; invoice and packing list show 24,800 kg

checklist.question: Who is the importer and what is their TIN?
checklist.settled_by: Invoice sold-to and B/L consignee agree

checklist.question: Who is the exporter and what is the country of origin?
What are the goods and what HS code applies?
checklist.settled_by: Invoice description; HS 6809.19 for plasterboard (gypsum articles, not faced only with paper)

checklist.question: How many packages, boards, and what gross and net weight?
checklist.settled_by: Packing list; B/L gross weight must agree

checklist.question: What is the invoice total, currency and incoterm, and the customs value in GMD?

checklist.question: Do weights, package counts, references and parties agree across all documents?
checklist.settled_by: Comparison of invoice, packing list, B/L, CoO. Expected discrepancies: B/L package count (806 vs 860) and B/L gross weight (24,080 vs 24,800 kg) disagree with invoice and packing list
